title: The Hard Border
author: E. M. Joubert
blurb: Beatrix Brightwater, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
